title: Program Draws Counted Against a Maximizer Benefit Load: Specialty Pharmacy Program Reconciliation Standard
content:
**Standard.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, a maximizer program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the program year named on its benefit load. The program draws taken off the latest benefit load are set by where today falls:

1. When today falls within the latest load's program year, the program draws taken off the load are those dated fewer whole months before today than the first day of that program year.
2. When the latest load's program year ended no more than 365 days before today, they are the draws dated no more whole months before today than the load itself.
3. Otherwise they are the draws of the last 12 months, meaning those dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**Definitions.**

- **Program draws** are the manufacturer program assistance applications on the enrollment's ledger, each dated by its entry date.
- **The load itself** is dated by the entry date of the latest benefit load.
- **Whole months.** The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

## Which window, by today's date (assumed load for program year 2026, entered 2026-01-20)

| Today | Situation | Draws taken off the load |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-25 | inside program year 2026 | draws dated fewer than 7 whole months before today, since January 1 lies 7 whole months back |
| 2027-02-10 | program year ended 41 days ago | draws dated no more than 12 whole months before today, since the load lies 12 whole months back |
| 2028-01-01 | program year ended 366 days ago | draws of the last 12 months |

## Draws tested against the first window (today assumed 2026-08-25, program year 2026)

| Draw dated | Whole months before today | Taken off the load? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-01 | 0 | Yes |
| 2026-01-28 | 6 | Yes |
| 2026-01-20 | 7 | No, because 7 is not fewer than 7 |

## The 365-day line

A program year ending 2026-12-31 ended 365 days before a today of 2027-12-31, so the second window still applies on that day. On 2028-01-01 it has ended 366 days before, and the third window applies.
